name: Conlet Plastics Inc
old_description: Located in New Milford, we have over 40 years of combined experience with plastic thermoforming & molding. Our product range includes heavy gauge forming, plastic covers, plastic housings, CNC routing, CNC milling, die cutting, in-house tooling, prototypes and long and short product runs.
about:
Conlet Plastics Inc operates from New Milford, Connecticut. The company does not disclose a founding year or founder names; it cites over 40 years of combined experience in plastic thermoforming and molding. Ownership details are not specified.

The shop provides plastic thermoforming and molding services, including heavy-gauge forming, plastic covers, and housings. Secondary processes encompass CNC routing, CNC milling, die cutting, and in-house tooling. The facility handles prototype through production volumes ranging from one to 100,000 parts, with wood, epoxy, or aluminum molds made on site or supplied by the customer. Approximately eight employees work across production and assembly/packaging areas that allow multiple projects to run simultaneously.

The company does not list specific industries or named customers; it describes its role as a specialized extension of client facilities.

Conlet Plastics emphasizes cost-conscious project review to prevent production issues, positioning itself as a partner that balances price, quality, and on-time delivery. Its location on Pickett District Road offers quick access to Route 7 and Interstate 84.
